name: researched-prices
title: VPS and proxy list prices by country, 2026-10 snapshot
description: Public list prices of VPS/VDS hosting (603 offers, 25 providers, 32 countries) and paid proxies (458 rows, 31 brands), taken from providers' own pricing pages between 2026-08-30 and 2026-09-24. RUB and EUR converted to USD at a fixed Bank of Russia snapshot dated 2026-09-24. Curated list, mostly providers relevant to Russian-speaking buyers.

sources.title: Providers' public pricing pages (one URL per row in source_url / official_url)
Bank of Russia daily exchange rates, 2026-09-24

resources.name: vps-plans
resources.title: VPS offers by country
resources.description: One row per visible VPS offer and country. Count offers with card_id.

fields.name: card_id
fields.description: Offer id: provider id and the id of the first merged plan. Repeats across countries.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Provider name.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: Plan name as published.

fields.name: plan_variants
fields.description: Other plan names merged into this offer in this country, joined by "; ".

fields.name: country
fields.description: Hosting country (English name).

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

fields.name: location
fields.description: City or datacenter as published, joined by "; ". Free text: city names, airport codes, country codes; 370 rows in Russian.

fields.name: os
fields.description: OS, only when sold as a separate plan: "Linux", "Linux; Windows".

fields.name: vcpu
fields.description: Number of vCPU.

fields.name: cpu_share_pct
fields.description: Guaranteed share of one core, only for fractional-core plans (5 Selectel rows, 10). Empty = full vCPU.

fields.name: ram_gb
fields.description: RAM in GB.

fields.name: storage_gb
fields.description: Disk size in GB.

fields.name: storage_type
fields.description: Disk type. Empty when not stated.

fields.name: traffic_tb
fields.description: TB per month, "unlimited", or empty when not stated. Text type because of "unlimited".

fields.name: port_mbps
fields.description: Port speed in Mbit/s. Empty when not published.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Price as published, in the provider currency, for price_period.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency of price.

fields.name: price_period
fields.description: "month", or "day" (11 Beget rows).

fields.name: price_usd_month
fields.description: Monthly USD price: daily price x 30, RUB and EUR converted at the fixed 2026-09-24 snapshot, USD as is.

fields.name: payment_crypto
fields.description: Provider lists a cryptocurrency. Empty = methods unknown (WAICORE, 1cent.host), not "no".

fields.name: payment_ru_cards
fields.description: Provider lists Mir, SBP or SberPay (a generic "Bank card" is not counted). Empty = unknown.

fields.name: payment_methods
fields.description: Provider-level list, joined by "; ". Not checked per plan.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Official page recorded as the source of the price, no referral parameters. May be a provider or product-family page.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Date the price was observed (YYYY-MM-DD). Earliest date if merged plans differ.

resources.name: proxy-prices
resources.title: Proxy entry prices by country
resources.description: One row per catalog row and country where the provider publishes per-country prices. Unit is 1 IP, 1 port or 1 GB.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Brand name.

fields.name: catalog_row
fields.description: Row name in the site catalog with variant suffix, e.g. "IPRoyal (ISP)". Suffixes of shared rows are in Russian.

fields.name: variant
fields.description: ISP or DC (static rows); static, mobile or residential (shared rows).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Catalog table of the row.

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code when the price is tied to a country; empty for all_countries and base rows without one.

fields.name: country_name
fields.description: English country name.

fields.name: price_scope
fields.description: country = exact price published for this country; reference_country = the single published price is for this country; all_countries = one price for all; base = no usable price.

fields.name: price_from
fields.description: Entry price in the provider currency. Empty when none is published.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: What price_from buys: 1 IP, 1 port or 1 GB. Do not compare across units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency of price_from.

fields.name: period_days
fields.description: Billing period: 30 for per-IP and per-port prices; mostly empty for per-GB prices.

fields.name: min_qty
fields.description: Minimum quantity for this per-piece price (1 = none), e.g. 100 IPs.

fields.name: price_usd
fields.description: price_from in USD (RUB at the fixed 2026-09-24 snapshot). Empty when price_from is empty.

fields.name: price_status
fields.description: verified = observed on the provider site; manual_review = a price exists but waits for re-check, not given; unavailable = no public price.

fields.name: trial
fields.description: Trial terms as recorded in the catalog (English); "No" if none.

fields.name: payment_crypto
fields.description: A cryptocurrency or crypto processor is listed.

fields.name: payment_ru_cards
fields.description: Mir, SBP or SberPay is listed.

fields.name: payment_methods
fields.description: Provider-level list, joined by "; ". Not checked per row.

fields.name: official_url
fields.description: Official provider page the price was taken from, no referral parameters.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Date the price was observed (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty for 2 rows without a usable price.
